runs.name: login
runs.goal: Log in as the standard user.

runs.name: add-bike-light
runs.goal: Log in, then add the Sauce Labs Bike Light to the cart.

runs.name: open-fleece-jacket
runs.goal: Log in and open the product detail page for the Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket.

runs.name: backpack-in-cart
runs.goal: Log in, put the Sauce Labs Backpack in the cart, and go to the cart page.

runs.name: checkout-onesie
runs.goal: Log in, buy the Sauce Labs Onesie: add it to the cart, check out with the given name and postal code, and finish the order.

runs.name: sort-price-low-high
runs.goal: Log in and sort the products by price from low to high.

runs.name: logout
runs.goal: Log in, then log out again using the side menu.

runs.name: two-items-remove-one
runs.goal: Log in, add the Backpack and the Bolt T-Shirt to the cart, then remove the Backpack so only one item is in the cart.

runs.name: open-menu
runs.goal: Log in and open the side menu so its links are visible.

runs.name: locked-out-error
runs.goal: Try to log in as the locked out user and get the error message.
